parts.text: As a dispatcher, I plan and run the flights for my company, deciding which drone flies and along which way, and I sign off each flight before it leaves. I can call off a flight, and several of us plan at the same time, often for the same busy sites and popular drones. Before and during a flight, things happen outside our control, like whether the load is ready, the drone reaching its job's points, and its arrival, which are reported by people and devices outside the company.
